meta.title: Radic Forma — 3D models and laser engraving
meta.description: Radic Forma designs and makes 3D printed objects and laser engravings on wood, acrylic, leather and metal. Where matter comes to life.

brand.lockup.alt: Radic Forma — Where matter comes to life

incisione.titolo: The difference is a tenth of a millimetre
incisione.testo: The beam travels the surface line by line and, on every pass, decides how much material to remove. Power, speed and number of passes are calibrated on each single material: it is that calibration, not the machine, that separates an engraved mark from a scorch.
incisione.nota: On every new material we run a stepped-power test piece, to find the point where the mark is crisp and the edge stays clean.

uno.nota: Acrylic, ABS and polycarbonate: satin engraving and clean-edged cutting.

due.nota: Permanent marking on stainless steel and anodised aluminium, with no loss of thickness.

tre.nota: Solid timber, plywood and MDF: the mark darkens by burning and the grain stays readable.

quattro.nota: A satin surface that contrasts with the colour, for plaques, signs and fittings.

cinque.nota: Slate and fine-grained stone: the mark stays pale against the dark ground, for plaques and coasters.

incisione.alt: The Radic Forma monogram is laser-engraved on a section of tree trunk: the beam descends line by line and leaves a dark brown burnt trace on the wood.

video.didascalia: The monogram engraved line by line on a section of tree trunk.

stampa3d.titolo: An object built one line at a time
stampa3d.testo: The nozzle lays molten filament along the perimeter and then fills the inside; the bed drops two tenths of a millimetre and it starts again. Every layer has to weld to the one below while it cools: that is where temperature and deposition speed decide whether the finished piece will hold.
stampa3d.nota: We orient the piece according to where it will work: with the same material, the direction of the layers changes its strength.

uno.nota: Rigid and dimensionally stable, for homeware and form prototypes.

due.nota: Resistant to moisture and impact, for pieces kept outdoors or handled often.

tre.nota: They withstand heat and sunlight, for technical components.

stampa3d.alt: The same monogram is 3D-printed on a build plate: the nozzle lays down green filament and the object grows layer after layer until it is complete.

video.didascalia: The same monogram built layer after layer on the build plate.

servizi.testo: Three ways of working matter, often combined in the same object.

uno.testo: Home and kitchen accessories, organisers, functional pieces. From short runs to one-offs, printed in FDM and finished by hand.

due.testo: Marking, personalisation and precision cutting on wood, acrylic, leather and anodised metal. Text, logos, graphic patterns and serial numbering.

tre.testo: We start from a sketch, a measurement or a practical problem and get to the production file. Modelling, dimensional checks and a test print.

tecnologie.testo: We work with two complementary technologies: fused deposition, which builds the object layer by layer, and the laser, which engraves and cuts by removing material. The choice depends on the material, the tolerance required and the number of pieces.

stampa.testo: Fused deposition printers with heated bed and automatic colour changing. Suited to functional parts, short runs and rapid prototypes.

laser.testo: A CNC laser source for raster engraving and vector cutting, with power and feed rate tuned to each material.

materiali.testo: Every material behaves differently: wood darkens, acrylic frosts, anodised aluminium lightens. On request we prepare a sample before production.
materiali.nota: Other materials on request, subject to a workability test.

uno.testo: You tell us what you need, even with a sketch or a photo. We assess feasibility, materials and timing.

due.testo: We prepare the 3D model or vector file and show you a preview before production.

tre.testo: We print or engrave, with a test piece whenever the material calls for one.

quattro.testo: Hand finishing, final inspection and shipping, or collection in person.

contatti.testo: Write to us with a description, a measurement or a reference photo: we reply with a feasibility assessment and a quote.
contatti.nota: We reply within [to be confirmed] working days.
